items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he said to Kimble... So, I don't know who Kimble was playing with that night. [INTERVIEWEE] I was from New York, I don't remember.

ctx.x: But, I know, I remember one night at Preservation Hall though, some guy came up, a white man, and he said to Kimble, You know, that's the first left handed banjo I've seen in a long time and I play banjo left handed. He said, I wonder if you'd let me play your banjo for one number. So, I don't know who Kimble was playing with that night. So the guy said, he said, okay. So they let the man sit down, he was great, he wasn't house though. But, and then he thanked Kimble and he said, you're the only other left handed…
I was from New York, I don't remember. You remember that night?
